judged_text: createEvent dropped the destinationCalendar.externalId fallback and now only matches a destination whose credentialId equals this credential's id, otherwise silently creating the event on 'primary'. adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent`, the calendarId is now chosen via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, and the insert uses `calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`. If the destinationCalendar entry has an `externalId` but no matching `credentialId` (or mismatched `credentialId`), `selectedCalendar` becomes undefined and the event is created on the organizer’s primary calendar instead of the selected destination. The previous logic used `destinationCalendar.externalId` directly (and the 404 mismatch was handled by catching 404). This diff shows the silent fallback-to-primary behavior the finding describes.
